payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results related to the effects of oversampling and transfer learning on cyberbullying detection models.

claims.text: Oversampling the bullying class improved the performance of DNN models significantly across all evaluation measures.
Transfer learning (TL1) resulted in low recall but higher precision, indicating cautious labeling of posts as bullying.
The nature of cyberbullying in the Formspring and Wikipedia datasets is more similar compared to the Twitter dataset.
